english.title: Unlawfully install / connect / arrange / use water fitting causing waste / misuse / undue consumption etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[installed]_
(B)_[connected]_
(C)_[arranged]_
(D)_[used]_

a water fitting in such a manner **(..SPECIFY MANNER..) that it caused or was likely to cause waste, misuse, undue consumption or contamination of water supplied by a water undertaker or water supply licensee
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 3(2)(i) and 7(1)(a) of the Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999.
